# William Valera · Head of IT & Business Systems

> Hands-on IT Manager based in Valencia, Spain, with 20+ years in technology and systems. Technical lead for the ERP (Microsoft Dynamics NAV), data, applications, AI, EU regulatory compliance, security and infrastructure of a distribution company. He analyses the need, decides the solution and leads its implementation with AI agents, reviewing and approving every change that reaches production.

## Profile
- Current role (2024–present): Business Systems, Automation & AI Lead, Arte Regal Import, S.L. (Valencia).
- 2018–2024: IT Consultant, ERP implementation (Microsoft Dynamics NAV), same company.
- 2005–2018: systems, support, networking and technical management roles in Venezuela.
- Education: Systems Analyst. Languages: Spanish (native), English (intermediate).

## Capabilities
- ERP: Microsoft Dynamics NAV, C/AL, NAS and Job Queue, SOAP, EDI.
- Data engineering: central data platform, incremental ETL from SQL Server to MySQL/MariaDB, validation and atomic publishing.
- Applied AI: tool-using agents, context-aware translation, multimodal image validation, voice transcription.
- AI-driven development: a team of 9 specialised AI agents with human approval.
- Full-stack and offline applications: FastAPI, Next.js, React, TypeScript, PWA.
- Business automation, security, infrastructure and operations.
- EU regulatory compliance: EUDR, CBAM and PPWR supplier tracking; CLP/GHS product-safety labelling.
